key_facts: July 21 FINAL-DAY MAJOR UPDATE (ANI/Asianet News Hindi July 21 8:13 PM IST, Hindustan Times late-night ASDMA bulletin July 21/22, HT Sikkim July 21, Down To Earth/Indian Express/India.com July 21): THREE huge developments reshaped the leaderboard! (1) HIMACHAL PRADESH (0.28->0.42, CLEAR #1): Himachal Revenue Minister Jagat Singh Negi officially told ANI on July 21 that 66 people have died in rain-related incidents in Himachal Pradesh in July alone (citing road accidents, landslides, and falling rocks), with 145 roads blocked, 508 transformers down, and active IMD Red Alerts (Kangra, Chamba, Sirmaur, Mandi, Kullu) plus active monsoon through July 26. Even discounting ~35-45% road-accident share (~36-43 pure flood/landslide), Himachal leads comfortably on headline official tallies and leads or ties on strict flood/landslide tallies. (2) ASSAM (0.10->0.28, SURGED TO #2): Late-night July 21/22 ASDMA bulletin reported 21 flood deaths in a SINGLE DAY (13 Sivasagar, 5 Charaideo, 2 Golaghat, 1 Jorhat), vaulting Assam from 10 to 31 pure flood deaths (27+ since July 19), with 5.65 lakh affected across 16 districts, 872 villages submerged, Dikhou & Disang above highest recorded flood levels, and IAF/NDRF deployed; unambiguous state with zero road-accident dilution and rapidly rising toll. (3) JAMMU AND KASHMIR (0.17->0.09): July 19-21 Poonch/Rajouri/Doda floods & landslides reached 23-27 confirmed dead + 7 missing (Down To Earth 27, HT 22-23), active rain continuing, but now trails both Himachal and Assam AND carries ~50-55% legal Union Territory exclusion discount. (4) SIKKIM (NEW -> 0.06): Catastrophic July 20-21 landslide at NHPC Teesta Stage VI hydel tunnel (Samardung, Namchi) left 8 bodies recovered and 19 workers still trapped 3 km deep (CM Golay explicitly called for evacuating bodies), effectively banking ~27 pure landslide deaths. (5) MAHARASHTRA (0.21->0.06): Banked ~16-25 early-July deaths but IMD confirms subdued rain over west-central India through ~July 26. Outside mass 0.09 covers Uttarakhand (~0.05; under Red Alert, Char Dham suspended, mostly lightning deaths so far), UP/Bihar/Nagaland (~0.04).
